description: This plot illustrates the relationship between "Recent Sequence Ratio (%)" and two distinct metrics: "Perplexity" and "GPU Mem. Ratio (%)", alongside their respective full cache baselines. The x-axis represents the "Recent Sequence Ratio (%)" on a linear scale ranging from 10 to 100, with tick marks spaced at intervals of 20. The plot features dual y-axes: the left y-axis measures "Perplexity" on a linear scale from 4.2 to 4.7 with tick intervals of 0.1, while the right y-axis measures "GPU Mem. Ratio (%)" on a linear scale from 40 to 100 with tick intervals of 10. Four lines are displayed on the graph. The "Perplexity" data is represented by a solid orange line with circular markers, plotted against the left y-axis; it begins at a value of approximately 4.59 at x=10, declines to 4.3 at x=40, rises slightly to 4.34 at x=60, dips to 4.29 at x=70, increases to 4.39 at x=90, and ends at approximately 4.38 at x=100. A corresponding baseline, "Full Cache PPL," is shown as a dashed dark red line that remains constant at approximately 4.38 across the entire x-axis. The "GPU Mem. Ratio" data is depicted by a solid blue line with circular markers, plotted against the right y-axis; it starts at approximately 40 at x=10, exhibits a gradual increase to approximately 48 at x=70, rises to 54 at x=80, spikes sharply to approximately 99 at x=90, and concludes at 100 at x=100. Finally, the "Full Cache GPU Mem." baseline is represented by a dashed blue line that remains constant at 100 across the entire x-axis.
